plans.note: Cap is mutual at greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims for confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnities, gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud and IP infringement; check consequential-damages carve-outs in 21.2 and savings language in 21.4. Likely compliant.

No Section 20 indemnity provisions appear in the outline; Section 9.3 cross-references 'Section 20.5' and 21.3 references indemnification obligations, but the substantive Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity text is missing from the document. Verify no indemnity clause exists elsewhere before marking missing.
Section 12.4 (second instance) imposes a two-year, all-territory non-compete on Customer — squarely prohibited; note the conflicting freedom-of-action language in 12.3 when redlining.

12.3 expressly disclaims exclusivity in our favour; however 7.2 (disclose-and-match before engaging another provider) and the take-or-pay in 2.1 operate as de facto exclusivity — allocate the match obligation primarily to MFN and the volume floor to MINCOMMIT to avoid double-flagging.
Section 7.2 (first instance) requires Customer to disclose and match any more favourable offer for Vendor's benefit — an MFN running against us, contrary to 12.3's disclaimer. Deviation.

Section 12.4 (first instance) bars soliciting, hiring or employing any Vendor employee for 24 months with no general-advertising carve-out and 'regardless of how the employee applies' — deviation; 12.3 contains the carve-out we want.

Termination rights are limited to breach, insolvency, security/SLA/legal/IP failures and force majeure; no Customer convenience termination on notice, and 2.1 expressly denies reduction or termination rights. Likely missing.
8.2 gives a 30-day non-renewal window plus a 60-day Vendor reminder with deadline extension; 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice. Likely compliant.

28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction (outside accepted list) while 28.2 gives exclusive New York County jurisdiction — direct conflict; flag 28.1 as the deviation and align with 28.2.
24.1 permits Customer assignment to Affiliates/successors without consent; 24.2 restricts Vendor; 24.4 bars Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control. Likely compliant.

14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data, but 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of every Deliverable with only a revocable, non-transferable term licence — deviation against 'we own what we pay for'; note tension with 13.2/14.3 perpetual licence.

13.1-13.3 cover Affiliates and contractors, perpetual paid-up rights and limited suspension only for uncured breach — compliant; the revocable Deliverable licence in 14.2 is addressed under IP to avoid double-flagging unless it independently breaches this rule.
22.1-22.3 limit audits to once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, off-site where practicable, Vendor-borne cost subject to a 5% underpayment shift, with no direct system access. Likely compliant.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer appears; the take-or-pay in 2.1 is economically similar but is handled under MINCOMMIT. Check 7.3 interest and 22.2 audit-cost shifting for penalty-like charges.

90-day Deliverable warranty plus term-long hosted conformance, malicious-code and compliance warranties, with repair/re-perform then terminate-and-refund remedy that is non-exclusive for key claims. Likely compliant.
18.1 sets CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M for the term plus one year; 18.2 covers certificates and non-limitation. Likely compliant.

Section 2.1 imposes USD 2,000,000 per year for three years take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' — a clear deviation requiring an exit/carry-forward and alignment with the termination rights in Section 9.

10.1-10.2 provide a transition period, Deliverable delivery and refunds, but check whether any clause (Section 11 is referenced in 16.5 but absent from the outline) requires Customer Data return/export in a usable format and priced transition assistance; may be a partial gap.
